pr.title: Prove the all-Dirichlet boundary 0.874861 (c = 0.125139)
pr.body:
QRH-Result: cycle61-c0125139
QRH-Bound: 874861/1000000
QRH-Decimal: 0.874861

This submission proves the all-Dirichlet zero-free half-plane Re(s) > 874861/1000000 (c = 0.125139), with the principal pole at s = 1 excluded. `Candidate.bound` has no additional analytic-estimate hypothesis. The accompanying paper follows the completed Lean construction and also states the zeta and finite-order Hecke comparison results.

The proof combines the earlier moment and physical-source framework with Gao’s local refinement, extends the required density range and numerical region, and completes the common-probe main/error estimates. The result package includes the manuscript, exact used-source inventory, unbundled local sources, transformation record and provenance. Hailey Collet is the sole human author; the paper distinguishes research direction and source integration from AI-produced derivations, drafting and formalization.

## Verification

The frozen original clean build passed all 3,695 modules with no submitted objects reused. The original all-Dirichlet, zeta and Hecke proof closures passed Comparator and Lean/NanoDa/con-ron. The transformed Candidate also passed a fresh 194-module compilation, the canonical all-Dirichlet Comparator and all three kernels; both whole replay launchers exited 0. The original-to-bundle reconstruction check passed.

Both local replays used the recorded native judge adapter because this host refuses the standard nested namespace setup. The trusted Comparator, protected inputs and official per-kernel sandboxes were retained. These local checks are documented in `proofs/cycle61-c0125139/Verification.md`; the tracker must independently check the exact submitted head through its unchanged protected workflow.
